Dhaabbatichi hanga amma doolaara biliyoona 3 qabachuun, maamiltoonni isaa miidhaa akka hin qaqqabneef waadaa galeera. Qaamoleen nageenyaa Amerikaa kan akka FBI fi Secret Service yakkitoota kana to’achuu fi qarshii hafe deebisuuf dhaabbaticha waliin hojjetaa jiru.

title: US inmate Christa Pike says she woke up 'confused and in pain' after failed execution
english: Christa Pike, an American death row inmate, has spoken out for the first time following a failed lethal injection execution in September. Pike, who survived the attempt, reports suffering from ongoing physical pain and emotional trauma since being returned to prison. She is believed to be the only person to have survived a lethal injection execution attempt.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የሞት ፍርድ ተፈርዶባት የነበረችው ክሪስታ ፓይክ፣ ባለፈው መስከረም ወር የተሞከረባት የግድያ ሙከራ ካመለጠች በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ መግለጫ ሰጥታለች። በሕይወት የተረፈችው ፓይክ፣ ወደ እስር ቤት ከተመለሰች በኋላ ከፍተኛ የአካል ሕመም እና የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ እየደረሰባት እንደሆነ ገልጻለች። በክትባት አማካኝነት በተሞከረ የግድያ ሙከራ በሕይወት የተረፈች ብቸኛ ሰው እንደሆነች ይታመናል።
oromo: Hiriibuu duuti itti murame Christa Pike, baatii Fulbaana keessa ajjeechaa ishee irratti yaalamee turerratti erga ooltee booda ibsa baastee jirti. Namattiin yaalii ajjeechaa kana oolte, mana hidhaatti erga deebitee booda dhukkubbii qaamaa fi miidhaa sammuu cimaa keessa akka jirtu ibsiteetti. Namattiin kun yaalii ajjeechaa kanaan lubbuun hafte ishee qofa akka taate himama.

title: Prominent Russian newspaper shuts down under pressure from authorities
english: Novaya Gazeta, a leading independent Russian newspaper known for its investigative work, has been forced to cease operations due to intense government pressure. The outlet accused authorities of effectively destroying the publication by cutting off its funding sources and issuing eviction notices. This closure marks the end of a long history of reporting on corruption and human rights, continuing a trend of state crackdowns on dissent since the invasion of Ukraine.
amharic: ኖቫያ ጋዜጣ የተሰኘው ታዋቂው የሩሲያ ገለልተኛ ጋዜጣ በመንግስት ከፍተኛ ጫና ምክንያት ስራውን ማቆሙን አስታውቋል። የጋዜጣው አመራሮች ባለስልጣናት የገቢ ምንጫቸውን በመዝጋት እና ከቢሮ በማስወጣት ተቋሙን እንዲዘጋ ማስገደዳቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ጋዜጣ በሩሲያ ውስጥ በሙስና እና በሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶች ላይ ሲዘግብ የቆየ ሲሆን፣ አሁን የተወሰደው እርምጃ በዩክሬን ጦርነት ወቅት በጋዜጠኞች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን የገደብ እና የጭቆና አካል ተደርጎ ታይቷል።
oromo: Gazexaan biyya Rashiya kan of danda'e fi beekamaa ta'e Novaya Gazeta, dhiibbaa mootummaan irratti godheen hojii isaa dhaabuuf dirqameera. Qondaaltonni mootummaa maddeen galii isaanii cufuudhaan akkasumas iddoo hojii irraa isaan ari'uudhaan dhaabbatichi akka cufu godhaniiru. Gazexaan kun waggoota dheeraaf yakka malaammaltummaa fi sarbamuu mirga namummaa gabaasaa kan ture yoo ta'u, cufamuun isaa kun duula mootummaan gabaasitoota irratti erga weerarri Yukreeni eegalee gaggeessaa jiru keessatti kan fudhatameedha.

title: Spain transport minister says he won't resign over high-speed rail disaster
english: Spain's transport minister, Óscar Puente, has refused to resign following a fatal high-speed train collision that killed at least 69 people near Toledo. Despite facing significant pressure and public protests, he stated that his current priority is to investigate the cause of the disaster rather than stepping down. Preliminary findings suggest a serious communication error occurred, where a moving train was cleared to proceed toward a stationary one following a system failure.
amharic: የስፔን የትራንስፖርት ሚኒስትር ኦስካር ፑዌንቴ በቶሌዶ አቅራቢያ ቢያንስ 69 ሰዎችን የገደለውን የባቡር አደጋ ተከትሎ ከስልጣን እንደማይለቁ አስታውቀዋል። ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ እና የስራ መልቀቂያ ጥያቄዎች ቢቀርቡላቸውም፣ ሚኒስትሩ አሁን ያለው ትኩረታቸው ከአደጋው ጋር በተያያዘ ስልጣን መልቀቅ ሳይሆን የችግሩን ምንጭ መመርመር እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። የመጀመሪያ መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ በስርዓት ብልሽት ምክንያት ተንቀሳቀስ የነበረው ባቡር በቆመ ባቡር ላይ እንዲጋጭ የተሳሳተ ትዕዛዝ መሰጠቱ ለዚህ አሰቃቂ አደጋ ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Ministirri geejjiba Ispeen Ooskaar Puweentee, naannoo Tooleedooitti balaa baaburaa lubbuu namoota 69 galaafateen walqabatee aangoo gadhiisuu didaniiru. Gidiraa fi mormii guddaa mudateen boodas, ministirichi dhimmi isaanii inni guddaan aangoo gadhiisuu utuu hin taane, sababa balaa kanaa qorachuu akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Qorannoon jalqabaa akka agarsiisutti, rakkoo teknoolojii booda baaburri deemaa ture inni biraa kan dhaabbate irratti akka bu'u ajajni dogoggoraa kennamuun isaa balaa kana akka fide himameera.

title: Barcelona’s Flick praises Yamal’s ‘mentality’ after missing out on Ballon d’Or
english: Barcelona manager Hansi Flick has praised Lamine Yamal for his professional attitude after the young star finished third in the recent Ballon d'Or voting. Despite missing out on the top prize, which went to Harry Kane, Yamal has remained focused and dedicated in training. Flick expressed his confidence in the team's ability to bounce back as they prepare for their upcoming match against Alaves following two recent losses.

oromo: Leenjisaan garee Barseloonaa Hansi Flick, lammiin dargaggeessa ta'e Lamine Yamal badhaasa 'Ballon d'Or' irratti sadarkaa sadaffaa ba'us, amala gaarii inni agarsiiseef galateeffataniiru. Badhaasichi Harry Kanef kennamee jiraatus, Yamal leenjii irratti xiyyeeffannoon hojjechaa jiraachuu isaatti leenjisaan kun gammachuu qabu. Barseloonaan taphoota lama darban injifatamuus, gareen kun tapha Alaves irratti injifannoo argachuuf qophaa'aa jira.

title: Chelsea vs Manchester United: Premier League – teams, prediction, lineups
english: Manchester United manager Michael Carrick is fighting to keep his job as his team prepares to face Chelsea this Saturday at Stamford Bridge. United is currently in poor form, sitting just one point above the relegation zone after an eight-game winless streak. The team is also dealing with internal tension following the benching of captain Bruno Fernandes and public criticism from players regarding club policies.
amharic: የማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ አሰልጣኝ ሚካኤል ካሪክ ቅዳሜ ዕለት በስታምፎርድ ብሪጅ ከቼልሲ ጋር በሚያደርጉት ጨዋታ ሥራቸውን ለማዳን እየታገሉ ነው። ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ በስምንት ተከታታይ ጨዋታዎች ድል ማጣቱን ተከትሎ ከሊጉ ወራጅ ቀጠና በላይ በአንድ ነጥብ ብቻ ተቀምጧል። በቡድኑ ውስጥ ካፒቴን ብሩኖ ፈርናንዴዝን ከመሰለፍ ማግለል እና የተጫዋቾች የውስጥ ቅሬታ ከፍተኛ የቡድን መከፋፈልን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Leenjisaan Manchester United Maaykil Kaarik Dilbata kana dirree Chelsea irratti taphachuuf qophaa'aa jiru kun, hojii isaa baraaruuf qormaata guddaa keessa jira. Manchester United taphoota saddeet darbaniif injifannoo argachuu dadhabuun isaa sadarkaa gadi bu'aa isa guddaa irratti akka argamu taasiseera. Gareen kun ammas kabajaa kapiteenii isaanii Bruno Fernandes irratti tarkaanfiin fudhatamuu fi komii taphattoonni siyaasa kilabii irratti qaban irraa kan ka'e rakkoo guddaa keessa jira.

title: Police in Scotland launch Andrew and Epstein royal castle investigation
english: Scottish police have started an investigation concerning Prince Andrew's past association with the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell. Authorities are looking into allegations that women were trafficked to the King's Balmoral estate, following the discovery of documents from US investigations. While the inquiry is currently in its initial phase, police have emphasized that they are prioritizing the needs of survivors as they gather evidence.

oromo: Poolisiin Iskootland akkaataa guddina isaanii duraanii Li'ul Andrew, yakkamaa saal-qunnamtii Jeffrii Epsteyinii fi Gisleyn Maaksweel wajjin qaban irratti qorannoo jalqabaniiru. Qorannoon kun kan jalqabame, dubartoonni gara naannoo Mootichi Balmoral qabanitti haala seeraan alaa geessamaa turuu isaanii irratti odeeffannoon argamuu isaatiin walqabatee dha. Qorannoon kun ammayyuu sadarkaa jalqabaa irra kan jiru ta'us, poolisiin odeeffannoo sassaabuun dura caalaatti fayyadamtoota ykn miidhamtoota irratti xiyyeeffachaa jiraachuu ibseera.

title: Arsenal boss Arteta fires ‘Disneyland’ warning at Dowman after red card
english: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta scolded 16-year-old talent Max Dowman after he received a red card during a surprise League Cup loss to Fleetwood Town. Despite some criticism regarding his harsh reaction toward the young player, Arteta stood by his decision, emphasizing that professional football requires high standards and discipline. Dowman, who is highly regarded at the club, will now serve a three-match suspension for the incident.
amharic: የአርሰናሉ አሰልጣኝ ሚኬል አርቴታ፣ የ16 ዓመቱ ተስፈኛ ተጫዋች ማክስ ዳውማን ከፍሊትዉድ ታውን ጋር በተደረገው የሊግ ካፕ ጨዋታ በቀይ ካርድ በመባረሩ ተግሳጽ ሰጥተውታል። አርቴታ ለወጣቱ ተጫዋች ባሳዩት ጠንካራ ምላሽ ትችት ቢሰነዘርባቸውም፣ ሙያዊ እግር ኳስ ከፍተኛ ተግሣጽና ድርጅትን እንደሚጠይቅ በመግለጽ ውሳኔያቸውን ተከላክለዋል። ዳውማን በጨዋታው ላሳየው ጥፋት የሶስት ጨዋታዎች ቅጣት ተላልፎበታል።
oromo: Leenjisaan Arsenal Mikel Arteta dargaggeessa umuriin isaa 16 ta'e Max Dowman tapha League Cup taphatameen kaardii diimaa argatee erga ari'amee booda isa balaaleffataniiru. Arteta gocha isaa kanaan qeeqa kan mudate ta'us, kubbaan miillaa ogeessa ta'e qophii fi adaba cimaa kan gaafatu ta'uu ibsuun murtee isaa ittiseera. Dowman gocha inni taphicha irratti raawwateen walqabatee dhorkaa tapha sadii itti murteeffameera.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Israel’s siege on Hebron displaces thousands
english: Israeli military operations and a siege in Hebron have resulted in the displacement of nearly 5,000 residents. In a related incident, a settler attacked a group of children at a local playground. Additionally, Israeli forces apprehended three Palestinians who were attempting to return to Gaza.
amharic: በኬብሮን ከተማ እየተካሄደ ባለው የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ከበባ ሳቢያ ወደ 5,000 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ከመኖሪያቸው ተፈናቅለዋል። በአካባቢው በሚገኝ መጫወቻ ስፍራ አንድ ሰፋሪ በልጆች ላይ ተኩስ ከፍቷል። ከዚህም በላይ እስራኤል ወደ ጋዛ ሲመለሱ የነበሩ ሶስት ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውላለች።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Heebroonitti marsaa taasiseen namoonni 5,000 ta'an qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru. Ta'ii biraatiin, namni biyya lafaa qabatee qubatu tokko iddoo daa'imman taphatanitti isaan irratti dhukaasa banuun isaa gabaafameera. Kana malees, waraanni Israa'el namoota gara Gaazaatti deebi'aa turan sadii hidhuu isaa ibsameera.

title: Residents leave devastated Russian-occupied Oleshky as evacuation corridor opens
english: A temporary ceasefire in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky has allowed for a humanitarian evacuation corridor. Approximately 750 residents are being transported out of the war-torn area via buses, while others have chosen to remain despite the lack of basic utilities like water and electricity. Officials have coordinated to ensure those leaving can travel safely, while humanitarian aid has been pledged to those who decide to stay behind.
amharic: በሩሲያ ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው የዩክሬን ከተማ ኦሌሽኪ በተደረሰ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት መሰረት ለነዋሪዎች የመውጫ ኮሪደር ተከፍቷል። በጦርነቱ የተጎዱት 750 የሚሆኑ ነዋሪዎች በአውቶቡስ እየተጓጓዙ ሲሆን፣ ሌሎች ነዋሪዎች ደግሞ የውሃ እና የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት ባይኖርም በከተማዋ ለመቆየት ወስነዋል። ባለስልጣናት ለቀው ለሚወጡት ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ ጉዞ ሲያመቻቹ፣ በከተማዋ ለሚቀሩትም ሰብአዊ እርዳታ እንዲደርስ ዝግጅት አድርገዋል።
oromo: Magalaa Oleshki tan humnoota Raashiyaan qabamte keessatti, waldhabdee dhaabuuf walii galteen erga mallattaa’ee booda, namoota magaalattii gadi lakkisanii bahuu barbaadaniif karaa nagaa ta’e banameera. Namoonni 750 ta’an konkolaataadhaan bakka nagaatti kan geeffaman yoo ta’u, kanneen biroo ammoo tajaajilli bishaanii fi ibsaa jiraachuu baatus magaalattii keessa turuu filataniiru. Aangooti kanneen bahuuf karoorfatan karaa nagaa akka bahan qindeessaa jiran yoo ta’u, kanneen magaalattii keessatti hafaniifis gargaarsi namoomaa akka dhiyaatu beekameera.

title: Syrians struggle with soaring prices as crisis challenges post-Assad recovery
english: Syrians are facing severe financial hardship due to a deepening cost-of-living crisis and rising fuel prices. Although President Ahmed al-Sharaa took power following the end of the Assad regime, economic recovery has been slow and difficult. Widespread public protests recently forced the government to reverse a fuel price hike that many citizens found unaffordable.
amharic: ሶሪያውያን እየተባባሰ በመጣው የኑሮ ውድነት እና የነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ፕሬዝዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራ ስልጣን ከያዙ በኋላ ሀገሪቱን ለማረጋጋት ጥረት ቢያደርጉም፣ የኢኮኖሚ መሻሻል ግን አዝጋሚ ሆኖ ተገኝቷል። በቅርቡ በኑሮ ውድነቱ የተነሳ የተነሳው የህዝብ ተቃውሞ መንግስት የነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪውን እንዲሰርዝ አስገድዶታል።
oromo: Siriyaanonni rakkoo gatii jireenyaa fi daballii gatii boba’aa cimaa ta’een kan ka’e rakkoo dinagdee hamaa keessa jiru. Preezidaant Ahmed al-Sharaa mootummaa Assad erga buusanii booda aangoo qabatanii biyya tasgabbeessuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiranis, diinagdeen biyyattii hatattamaan fooyya'uu dadhabeera. Rakkoo kana irraa kan ka'e uummanni hedduun mormii waan kaaseef, mootummaan daballii gatii boba'aa irratti godhe akka haqamu dirqameera.

title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam
english: A Kenyan national named Francis Mogambi has been indicted in the U.S. for his role in a $130 million scheme involving fraudulent student aid applications. Prosecutors allege he used stolen identities of American citizens to enroll fake students in colleges and divert their government financial aid to himself and associates. This case is part of a larger federal investigation known as Operation Ghostbusters, which seeks to hold accountable those who stole personal information to defraud the U.S. taxpayer.
amharic: ፍራንሲስ ሞጋምቢ የተባለ የኬንያ ዜጋ በአሜሪካ የ130 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የትምህርት ድጋፍ ማጭበርበር ወንጀል ተጠርጥሮ ክስ ቀረበበት። ተጠርጣሪው የአሜሪካ ዜጎችን መታወቂያ በመስረቅና የውሸት ተማሪዎችን በኮሌጆች በመመዝገብ በመንግስት የሚሰጥ የትምህርት ዕርዳታ ገንዘብ ሲቀበሉ እንደነበር ተገልጿል። ይህ ጉዳይ 'ኦፕሬሽን ጎስትበስተርስ' በተሰኘው መጠነ ሰፊ የአሜሪካ የፌዴራል ምርመራ አካል ሲሆን፣ የህዝብ ግብርን በአጭበርባሪ መንገድ የወሰዱ አካላትን ለፍርድ ለማቅረብ እየተሰራ ነው።
oromo: Lammiin Keeniyaa, Firaansiis Mogambii jedhamu, Ameerikaa keessatti yakka gowwomsaa gargaarsa barattootaa kan dolaara miiliyoona 130 liqimse jedhamee shakkameera. Mogambiin namoota Ameerikaa biroo beekuu malee eenyummaa isaanii hatuudhaan, barattoota sobaa kolleejjiiwwanitti galchuudhaan maallaqa gargaarsa mootummaa hatuuf yaalaniiru. Dhimmi kun qorannoo guddaa 'Operation Ghostbusters' jedhamu kan mootummaan Ameerikaa maallaqa gibiraa hatame deebisuuf fi yakka kana irratti bobba'an seeraan gaafachuuf taasisu keessatti qabameera.

title: Helicopter carrying six people crashes in northern Indian state
english: A helicopter carrying six individuals, including five pilgrims, crashed near Joshimath in the Indian state of Uttarakhand after departing from the Badrinath shrine. Rescue teams have been deployed to the remote mountainous area to locate survivors, though the current status of those on board is unknown. Officials are investigating the cause of the crash, which occurred during a period of heavy rain and poor weather conditions.
amharic: አምስት ምዕመናንን ጨምሮ ስድስት ሰዎችን የጫነ ሄሊኮፕተር ከባድሪናት ተነስቶ በህንድ የኡታራካንድ ግዛት በጆሺማት አቅራቢያ ተከስክሷል። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች ተጎጂዎችን ለመፈለግ ወደ ተራራማው አካባቢ የተሰማሩ ሲሆን፣ በቦርዱ የነበሩት ሰዎች ሁኔታ እስካሁን አልታወቀም። አደጋው የተከሰተው በክልሉ በነበረው ከባድ ዝናብ እና መጥፎ የአየር ሁኔታ መሆኑን ተከትሎ፣ ባለስልጣናት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Namoota ja'a, isaan keessaa imaltoota shan kan qabate xiyyaarri daandii qilleensaa (helicopter) tokko Badrinaatii ka'ee osoo deemu naannoo Joshimath, kan mootummaa naannoo Uttarakhanditti argamuutti kukkufeera. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa bakka rakkoon kun itti uumamee fi naannoo gaarreenitti namoota barbaaduuf bobba'aniiru, ta'us haalli namoota xiyyaarichaa keessa turanii hanga ammaatti hin beekamu. Balaan kun kan uumame yeroo roobni cimaa fi haalli qilleensaa mijataa hin turretti waan ta'eef, aangotni dhimmi kana qorachaa jiru.

title: Palestinian voter turnout exposes Israel’s attitude towards Arab citizens
english: A former PLO official, Xavier Abu Eid, argues that high voter participation among Arab citizens has highlighted significant issues regarding their treatment in Israel’s political system. The situation is complicated by controversies surrounding the election process and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s ongoing efforts to maintain his leadership. This high turnout serves as a focal point for broader discussions about the rights and status of Arab Israelis within the country's democracy.
amharic: የቀድሞው የፍልስጤም ነጻ አውጪ ድርጅት ባለስልጣን ዛቪየር አቡ ኢድ፣ በአረብ እስራኤላውያን ከፍተኛ የምርጫ ተሳትፎ መታየቱ በእስራኤል የፖለቲካ ስርዓት ውስጥ ስላላቸው አያያዝ አሳሳቢ ጉዳዮችን እንዳጋለጠ ገልጸዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ስልጣን ላይ ለመቆየት በሚያደርጉት ጥረት እና በምርጫው ሂደት ዙሪያ በተነሱ አወዛጋቢ ክሶች ምክንያት ጉዳዩ ይበልጥ ውስብስብ ሆኗል። ይህ ከፍተኛ የመራጮች ተሳትፎ በአገሪቱ ዲሞክራሲ ውስጥ የአረብ ዜጎች መብትና ቦታ ላይ ትልቅ ክርክር ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni duraanii dhaabbata bilisummaa Falasxiin (PLO) Xavier Abu Eid, hirmaannaan ol aanaa lammiilee Arabaa filannoo irratti argisiisaniin, sirna demokraasii Israa'el keessatti dhimmi namoota kanaa akka gaariitti ilaalamaa akka hin jirre ifa godheera. Haalli kun ergaa ministira muummee Biniyaamin Netaaniyaahuu kan aangoo irra turuuf yaalii godhanifi shakkiiwwan adeemsa filannoo irratti ka'aniin wal qabatee kan ulfaate dha. Hirmaannaan kun haqaafi bakka lammiilee Arabaa biyyattii keessatti qaban irratti marii guddaa kaaseera.

title: Russia ‘forces’ closure of investigative newspaper Novaya Gazeta
english: The prominent independent Russian newspaper Novaya Gazeta has been forced to shut down after decades of operation due to intense pressure from the Kremlin. Authorities labeled the outlet a 'foreign agent' and conducted raids and arrests targeting its leadership, effectively silencing one of the country's last remaining critical voices. This move represents a significant escalation in the government's ongoing crackdown on media freedom since the invasion of Ukraine.
amharic: ታዋቂው የሩሲያ ነጻ ጋዜጣ ኖቫያ ጋዜታ በክሬምሊን ከፍተኛ ጫና ምክንያት ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት ከቆየ በኋላ ስራውን ለማቆም ተገዷል። የሩሲያ መንግስት ጋዜጣውን 'የውጭ ወኪል' በማለት ከመፈረጁም በላይ በአርታኢዎቹ ላይ እስር እና ፍተሻ በማካሄድ የመጨረሻውን የነጻ ሃሳብ አንጸባራቂ ተቋም ዝግ እንዲሆን አድርጓል። ይህ እርምጃ ከዩክሬን ጦርነት በኋላ በሩሲያ የሚዲያ ነጻነት ላይ እየተደረገ ያለውን አፈና የሚያሳይ ትልቅ ክስተት ነው።
oromo: Gaazexaan biyya Russia kanneen walaba ta'an keessaa beekamaa kan ta'e 'Novaya Gazeta' dhiibbaa mootummaan irratti godheen hojii isaa dhaabuuf dirqameera. Mootummaan biyyattii gaazexicha 'ajentii alaa' jechuun erga maqaa baleessee booda, qondaaltota isaa hidhuu fi manaa fi waajjira isaanitti duuluun sagalee bilisaa kana ukkaamsuuf yaalera. Tarkaanfiin kun lola Yukreen booda mootummaan Russia mirga miidiyaa irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachaa jiru kan ibsuudha.

title: Activists urge Eisenkot to form new Israeli gov’t with Arab parties
english: Political activists are pushing for Gadi Eisenkot to establish a new Israeli government that includes Arab political parties. This movement highlights a significant effort to shift the current political landscape through inclusive cooperation. The initiative seeks to bridge divides and foster a more diverse legislative coalition.

title: How can Israel break its election deadlock?
english: Israel is facing a political deadlock following its recent election, as neither Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc nor Gadi Eisenkot’s opposition reached the 61-seat majority required to form a government. Because neither side is willing to partner with the Arab-led political lists, the nation must now rely on complex coalition negotiations. If these talks fail, President Isaac Herzog will appoint candidates to attempt to build a stable government within specific legal timeframes.
